name: editor-ia
description: Local-first AI-assisted video editor for Windows: timeline, script, local narration and verified FFmpeg export.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/project-schema/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/render-worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:extension && npm run test:web-tts
scripts.tauri:dev: node scripts/setup-ffmpeg-dev.mjs --quiet --runtime && node scripts/rust-env.mjs -- npm --workspace @editor-ia/desktop run tauri:dev
scripts.tauri:build: node scripts/setup-ffmpeg-dev.mjs --quiet --runtime && node scripts/rust-env.mjs -- npm --workspace @editor-ia/desktop run tauri:build
scripts.tauri:build:debug: node scripts/setup-ffmpeg-dev.mjs --quiet --runtime && node scripts/rust-env.mjs -- npm --workspace @editor-ia/desktop run tauri:build -- --debug --no-bundle
